description.value: Brassneck Brewery is a well-established craft brewery on Vancouver's Main Street corridor, celebrated for a rotating lineup of inventive beers spanning crisp Kölsch to barrel-aged fruit ales and double-digit stouts. The tasting room at 2148 Main Street offers draft pours and cans to go, with food sourced from sister restaurant The Magnet. It sits in one of Vancouver's most bike-friendly neighbourhoods, making it a natural stop for cyclists exploring the city.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 16m; rack (3 spaces, covered) at 44m; stands (6 spaces, covered) at 79m. Total: 11 spaces.
